name: Hermes TEMP - Apply DentalGest Safe RPC Stubs
description: Temporary manual workflow to apply non-destructive no-op/empty RPC compatibility functions for DentalGest n8n workflows.

parameters.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.n8n_reminders_24h()
RETURNS TABLE (
  id text,
  "organizationId" text,
  "patientName" text,
  "patientEmail" text,
  "patientPhone" text,
  "doctorName" text,
  "clinicName" text,
  "dateTime" timestamptz,
  "whatsappAddon" boolean,
  "whatsappPhoneNumberId" text,
  "whatsappAccessToken" text
)
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT
    NULL::text AS id,
    NULL::text AS "organizationId",
    NULL::text AS "patientName",
    NULL::text AS "patientEmail",
    NULL::text AS "patientPhone",
    NULL::text AS "doctorName",
    NULL::text AS "clinicName",
    NULL::timestamptz AS "dateTime",
    false AS "whatsappAddon",
    NULL::text AS "whatsappPhoneNumberId",
    NULL::text AS "whatsappAccessToken"
  WHERE false;
$$;

SELECT count(*)::int AS function_count
FROM pg_proc p
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
  AND p.proname IN (
    'n8n_reminders_24h',
    'n8n_reminders_2h',
    'n8n_mark_reminder24_sent',
    'n8n_mark_reminder2h_sent',

  );
